title: Mechamato The Animated Series
description: This series tells the story of a kind and creative boy named Amato, who comes across a prison spaceship housing many evil robots. One of them is MechaBot, who has the ability to mechanize everyday objects into high tech devices. Amato outsmarts MechaBot and becomes his master. The two bond together as friends over the course of the series and team up in the form of a superhero named Mechamato to locate and capture the evil robots that had escaped the fallen spacecraft.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 1x1
episodes_data.description: On their way to school, Amato and MechaBot has just encountered a cone-shaped robots called Konchos who has been causing a rampage on Kota Hilir.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 1x2
episodes_data.description: When Amato, MechaBot, and Pian are going to the beach, a fridge-like robot called Sejukku has the ability to froze the entire Kota Hilir. So it's up to Amato and MechaBot to stop him.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 1x3
episodes_data.description: After capturing a goose-like robot called Goosar, MechaBot has ran out of battery which Amato and Pian brought him to a crashed spaceship where they have to deal with a cube-shaped giant robot called Rubika.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 1x4
episodes_data.description: Mr. Jamie has been kidnapped by an overconfident and challenging robot named Amazeey who had turned the entire school into a labyrinth, so it's up to Amato, MechaBot, Mara and Deep to save him before it's too late.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 1x5
episodes_data.description: Amato receives a call for help from Pian, who's being stalked in his home by a robot with bad intentions.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 1x6
episodes_data.description: Amato sets out to find who is responsible for a series of videos on social media involving people in embarrassing situations.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 1x7
episodes_data.description: Amato looks into a case involving a stolen piece of art, but things take a serious turn when the one responsible begins kidnapping children.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 1x8
episodes_data.description: Someone's terrible singing keeps Amato up every night while he tries to study for his exams. Amato finds out the voice belongs to Karok, a bad robot, who has to be stopped before Amato fails his exams.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 1x9
episodes_data.description: By accident, Amato and MechaBot are transported into a retro video game world, and the only way out is to beat the game.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 1x10
episodes_data.description: Amato and friends rush to put out a fire, but they suspect someone or something may be behind it.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 1x11
episodes_data.description: It's Sports Day at school, and Amato has his sights on the top prize, but a robotic challenger appears to dash his hopes.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 1x12
episodes_data.description: While camping in the forest, Amato and friends come across a mysterious mansion made of toy blocks.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 1x13
episodes_data.description: After a bad robot robs Uncle Gobi's store, Amato and friends set out to find it by following its trail of destruction.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 2x1
episodes_data.description: A brutal food review drives robo-chef Garamsey to kidnap Deep. Amato has to save Deep before he becomes the next course.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 2x2
episodes_data.description: Amato and friends stay late after school to finish a project, but they soon realize that they are not alone.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 2x3
episodes_data.description: Amato and Pian try to rehabilitate the bad robots but an accident gives the bad robot Scarescrew a chance to escape.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 2x4
episodes_data.description: Amato's Mechanizer has been taken over by King Boxell. To stop him, the kids have to enter the digital Mechanizer World.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 2x5
episodes_data.description: Amato and friends visit a newly reopened game arcade, but unknown to them it's a trap laid by the bad robot Arcada.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 2x6
episodes_data.description: While searching for plastic bottles for their class project, Amato and friends meet a recycling robot made from plastic.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 2x7
episodes_data.description: Amato recounts the story of when CarBro and JetSis crashed the previous year's Destar Prix go-kart race.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 2x8
episodes_data.description: Amato gets news that the Konchozoku are stirring up trouble, and they're so bad even the Cone Kochos are scared of them.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 2x9
episodes_data.description: The bad robot Cloudiva is causing freak weather events around town. Amato has to stop her, before things get even worse.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 2x10
episodes_data.description: Amato and friends find a mysterious board game which transports them into its world, and the only way out is to win.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 2x11
episodes_data.description: Amato and MechaBot are invited to a children's show hosted by squirrel mascot Toopee, but things get weird really fast.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 2x12
episodes_data.description: Amato's attempt to capture the bad robot Shleep is thwarted by the arrival of an alien named Chachix.

episodes_data.title: Mechamato The Animated Series 2x13
episodes_data.description: The bad robots are loose and Chachix plans to capture and control them all. Amato has to stop Chachix once and for all.
